battle.name: 征服高盧帝國
battle.brief: 公元274年初，奧勒良自阿爾卑斯山北進高盧，與自特里爾南下的高盧帝國軍在香檳平原會戰，特里庫斯一世敗降，高盧帝國隨之解體。卡面的秦連弩是東亞的連發弩機，本役現場並無此物，西方同位裝備是扭力弩砲與複合弓。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 這場戰爭是公元274年羅馬帝國在高盧北部對高盧帝國的最終戰役。羅馬一方是皇帝盧基烏斯·多米提烏斯·奧勒良努斯（Aurelian，約公元207年或214年生，270至275年在位）指揮的中央軍：主力為駐紮在高盧、不列顛與萊茵各行省的軍團步兵與帝國騎兵，輔以近衛部隊與行省徵召的輔助軍；他在伊利里亞軍團推戴下於271年即位，272至273年先平定帕爾米拉帝國，273年末把兵鋒轉回西方。高盧一方是260年以來脫離中央的割據政權「高盧帝國」，首都設在萊茵下游的科隆尼亞阿格里披尼亞（Colonia Agrippina，今德國科隆），皇帝是特里庫斯一世，國土包括高盧、不列顛與西北西班牙；其軍隊以高盧人、日耳曼人與西班牙兵為主，另有受雇於割據者的傭兵，編制上並非帝國正規軍團，而是各地軍閥徵集、臨時拼湊的部隊。科隆等城市自設鑄幣廠，自鑄帶有高盧統治者名號的銅幣，說明其稅收與造幣機構已與羅馬中樞脫節。第三方還有盤據不列顛與北海沿岸的卡勞秀斯，以及前線總督佐提庫斯。
countriesEn: This was the final campaign of AD 274, in which the Roman Empire finished off the Gallic Empire in northern Gaul. On the Roman side stood the central army of Lucius Domitius Aurelianus (Aurelian, born about AD 207 or 214, reigning from 270 to 275): the core was legionary infantry and imperial cavalry garrisoned in the provinces of Gaul, Britain and the Rhine, supported by household troops and auxiliaries levied in the provinces. He had been raised to the purple by the Illyrian troops, had broken the Palmyrene Empire in the east in 272 and 273, and turned his forces back to the west in late 273. The opposing side was the state that had broken away from Rome in 260, the so-called Gallic Empire, with its capital at Colonia Agrippina on the lower Rhine, present-day Cologne in Germany, and its emperor Tetricus I; it held Gaul, Britain and north-western Hispania, and fielded mainly Gallic, Germanic and Spanish troops together with mercenaries hired by the separatist rulers. Its order of battle was not built on the regular legions of the Empire but on troops raised by local military men and patched together for the occasion. Cities such as Cologne kept their own mints and struck bronze coinage bearing the names of the Gallic rulers, which shows that the fiscal and monetary apparatus of the west had already drifted away from the Roman centre. Third parties were Carausius, who ruled Britain and the Channel coasts as a maritime state of his own, and Zoticus, formerly governor of Gaul.
people: 奧勒良是本役的決策者：274年初他放棄阿爾卑斯山以南的防務，把軍隊自意大利調入高盧北部，選擇在特里爾與香檳之間的地帶迎敵，避免讓特里庫斯把主力帶到科隆的城牆下硬碰。《古史》（Historia Augusta）形容他治軍嚴厲多疑，行事頗有共和執政官的作風，習慣同軍中將校與行省代表議事；他也因推行貨幣與軍紀改革而得罪首都的造幣工人與部分元老。特里庫斯一世是高盧帝國的末代皇帝，在位約四年，272年自創「奧勒良落選者」的稱號，用以對抗羅馬的正統帝號；其治下另有人以「特里庫斯二世」的名號出現，是否另有一人尚有爭議。佐提庫斯即芝諾比亞之父，曾任高盧總督，272至273年被奧勒良打敗後逃入特里庫斯的軍營。史家維克托、尤特羅匹烏斯、《古史》與奧羅西烏斯都記載了會戰，並說特里庫斯事先與奧勒良私約，願意出賣自己的軍隊以換取體面的投降，援引維吉爾《埃涅阿斯紀》中帕里努魯斯的鬼魂之言：把無敵者從困境中拉出來吧；今人亦指出這段敘事可能出自羅馬方面的宣傳。未列顛的卡勞秀斯自286年另行稱帝，與本役同時存在卻互不干涉，其本人於293年被自己人阿勒克圖斯所殺。
peopleEn: Aurelian was the man who decided the course of the campaign: at the beginning of 274 he gave up the defence of the Alps south of Italy, marched his army from Italy into northern Gaul, and chose to fight in the belt between Trier and Châlons rather than let Tetricus bring his main force down against the walls of Cologne. The Historia Augusta presents him as a severe and suspicious ruler who governed in a manner reminiscent of the Republican consuls, consulting his officers and the representatives of the provinces; his reforms of the coinage and of military discipline also made enemies of the mint workers of the capital and of some of the senators. Tetricus I, the last emperor of the Gallic Empire, ruled for about four years and in 272 adopted the title of the one whom Aurelian did not choose, claiming a legitimacy of his own against Rome; another name, Tetricus II, also appears on Gallic issues, and whether that was a second person or the same ruler is still debated. Zoticus, the father of Zenobia, had governed Gaul and, after being beaten by Aurelian in 272 or 273, fled into Tetricus' camp. Victor, Eutropius, the Historia Augusta and Orosius all describe the battle and report that Tetricus had come to a private understanding with Aurelian, offering to betray his own men in exchange for an honourable surrender, and quoting the ghost of Palinurus in Virgil's Aeneid: pluck me out, O unconquered one, from these troubles; modern scholars have suggested that this narrative may be Roman propaganda. Carausius, who ruled Britain independently from 286, existed at the same time but did not intervene, and he was killed by his own successor Allectus in 293.
kits: 卡面兵器是中國的秦連弩（Repeating crossbow，約公元前200年），是把弩機的張力儲存起來、以腳踏或拉桿逐次上弦、一按即發一矢的連發弩具，自戰國晚期起主要用於守城壓制與陣前封鎖，弩手編制固定，成排的連發可以覆蓋城頭一線，把攀梯與填壕的攻城部隊壓在牆外；它並不出現在公元274年的高盧戰場上，卡牌在此只作技術對照。西方與它功能同位的是扭力弩砲：維吉留斯《軍備論》記載的 cheiroballista 臂長約一肘，發射約一磅重的弩矢，拉力約一百二十磅（按羅馬制計），既可架在城頭，也可拆下、絞盤重置後隨軍轉移；不過羅馬野戰部隊自共和末期起已不再配發這種手提弩砲，它多半留在攻城與守城裝備中。羅馬攻城器械另有擲石砲與配重式投石機，配撞槌與可移動的攻城塔，工兵隨軍攜帶斧、鏟與橋車，用於築壘與架橋。高盧帝國軍以大盾與長劍近戰，用標槍和短投槍遮蔽正面，弓箭手多為日耳曼與西班牙募兵，配複合弓與短矛，陣中另有斧兵。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Chinese repeating crossbow, dated to about 200 BC: a crossbow mechanism that stores the strain of the drawn string so that a soldier can cock it again by foot or lever and fire a single bolt by pressing a trigger. From the late Warring States period it was used mainly to hold besiegers down from the walls and to seal a position before a general engagement, its crews organised in fixed detachments whose volleys could cover a whole stretch of wall and pin ladder-carrying and trench-filling parties against the ramparts. It was not present on the battlefield of Gaul in AD 274, and the card stands only as a technical parallel. The Western equivalent in function was the torsion artillery: the cheiroballista described by Vegetius had arms about a cubit in length, fired bolts of roughly a pound in weight at a pull of about one hundred and twenty pounds on the Roman scale, and could be set on a wall or dismantled, its windlass reset and carried along with the column; by the end of the Republic, however, Roman field armies no longer carried this hand-held engine, and it remained mostly in siege and garrison equipment. Roman siege trains also held stone-throwers and counterweight engines, together with battering rams and mobile towers, while the engineers carried axes, spades and bridging gear to build camps and cross rivers. The troops of the Gallic Empire fought at close quarters with long swords and large shields, covered their front with javelins and short throwing spears, and drew most of their archers from Germanic and Spanish recruits armed with composite bows, with axe-men also appearing in the line.
tactics: 奧勒良的部署圍繞速度與分割。273年冬他在意大利完成東征後的整頓，274年初自阿爾卑斯山山口進入高盧，直取科隆尼亞的補給與鑄幣資源；特里庫斯不願坐守首都，率軍自特里爾南下迎戰，結果在香檳平原被羅軍正面攔截，前線與首都之間的聯繫被切斷。會戰中羅軍以步兵縱隊在前、騎兵兩翼機動，密集衝鋒使高盧陣線的勇猛失去縱深；特里庫斯的部隊在主將被俘之後士氣迅速崩潰，大批部眾退回城中。羅軍隨後控制高盧主要城邑，鑄幣廠在274年3月前改鑄奧勒良的錢幣，行政與財政機構完成接收。糧秣沿軍道與萊茵河航運徵發，冬季宿營借用高盧城邑的營房。接著奧勒良北上萊茵，進入不列顛，接受島上北部諸部落的歸順，隨即退回萊茵沿岸，沒有留下足以長期控制南部的常駐軍隊。
tacticsEn: Aurelian's plan rested on speed and separation. After finishing the war in the east and reorganising his army in Italy during the winter of 273, he crossed into Gaul through the Alpine passes in early 274 and went straight for the supplies and the mints of Colonia Agrippina. Tetricus would not sit behind his capital and marched south from Trier to meet him, only to be intercepted head on in the plain of Champagne, so that the link between the front and the capital was cut. In the fighting the Roman line closed up in infantry columns with cavalry working on both wings, and the massed charge robbed the Gallic ranks of the depth that their bravery alone could not supply; the morale of Tetricus' men broke as soon as their commander was taken, and large numbers fell back into the towns. The Roman army then held the main cities of Gaul, and the mints had changed over to Aurelian's coinage by March 274, which is how the transfer of the administration and the finances was carried through. Grain and fodder were drawn from the military roads and from river transport on the Rhine, and the army wintered in the towns of Gaul. Aurelian next pushed north across the Rhine into Britain, received the submission of the tribes in the north of the island, and then withdrew to the Rhine without leaving behind any permanent force able to hold the south.
data: 有可靠憑據的數字有限。時間上，會戰一般定在公元274年2月或3月，羅馬方面的四部史料都提到高盧的鑄幣廠最遲在274年3月改鑄奧勒良的錢幣，可作政權交接的下限；戰場的具體村落至今無法確定，只能落在香檳一帶。奧勒良在位於270至275年，271年3月在奧古斯塔陶里諾魯姆（今都靈）即位，272年攻取帕爾米拉，273年擒獲芝諾比亞，275年10月遇刺於拜占庭附近，這些時點界定了本役的上限。高盧帝國自260年立國到274年覆亡，前後約十四年，其間更替了數位統治者；帕爾米拉帝國存在約三年；特里庫斯在位約四年。地名上，特里爾（Augusta Treverorum）至香檳約三百五十公里，羅馬沿大道至香檳約九百公里，萊茵下游的科隆距戰場約四百公里。雙方投入的兵力、陣亡與俘虜數字沒有留下可信記載，羅軍對城邑的接收也只能由新幣流通與奧勒良「高盧的恢復者」（Restitutor Galliae）幣銘推知。
dataEn: Few reliable figures survive. As to time, the battle is usually dated to February or March 274, and all four Roman sources note that the Gallic mints had changed over to Aurelian's coinage by March 274 at the latest, which gives a lower limit for the handover of power; the exact village that was fought over cannot be fixed today and the field can only be placed in the region of Champagne. Aurelian reigned from 270 to 275: he was acclaimed at Augusta Taurinorum, modern Turin, in March 271, took Palmyra in 272, captured Zenobia in 273, and was killed near Byzantium in October 275, and these points bracket the campaign from above. The Gallic Empire lasted about fourteen years, from its foundation in 260 to its end in 274, with several rulers in between; the Palmyrene Empire existed for about three years; and Tetricus ruled for roughly four years. As to distance, it is about three hundred and fifty kilometres from Trier, Augusta Treverorum, to Châlons, some nine hundred kilometres along the Roman road from Rome to the same place, and roughly four hundred kilometres from the lower Rhine city of Cologne to the field. There is no trustworthy record of the numbers of men committed on either side, of losses or of prisoners; the Roman takeover of the towns can only be inferred from the new coinage and from the coin legend naming Aurelian Restitutor Galliae, restorer of Gaul.
cause: 這場戰爭是三世紀危機的收尾。公元235年之後，羅馬帝國在二十多年間經歷了二十餘位皇帝，軍隊叛亂、瘟疫與邊防線崩潰使中央一時失序，高盧與日耳曼行省的將領自行推舉皇帝，形成以科隆為都的高盧帝國，並在十四年裡相繼換了數位統治者；高盧土地肥沃、盛產糧食與兵源，萊茵防線與行省城市又相當富裕，割據者才有能力自立。同一時期，奧勒良所代表的中央軍在東方擊敗芝諾比亞的帕爾米拉帝國，272年奪回地中海東岸，273年俘獲其女王。274年初，奧勒良把重心西移，他既要面對拒絕承認中央的高盧帝國，也要處理不列顛分離者卡勞秀斯的沿海政權；高盧方面的佐提庫斯曾奉命率軍東進支援芝諾比亞，被打敗之後才退入特里庫斯的軍中，因此東西兩線的戰事，實為同一場內亂的兩端。對奧勒良本人而言，收回高盧亦是鞏固軍中權威的必要手段：他以行省議事與厲行軍紀立威，需要一場不容置疑的勝利。
causeEn: This war was the closing act of the crisis of the third century. After AD 235 the Roman Empire passed through more than twenty emperors in barely a quarter of a century; with army revolts, plague and collapsing frontiers the centre lost its grip, and the generals of the Gallic and German provinces raised emperors of their own and formed a Gallic Empire centred on Cologne, whose occupant changed several times in the following fourteen years. Gaul was fertile, rich in grain and in manpower, and its cities and the Rhine line were wealthy, which is what allowed the separatists to stand on their own. At the same time the central army represented by Aurelian broke the Palmyrene Empire of Zenobia in the east, retook the eastern Mediterranean littoral in 272 and took the queen captive in 273. At the beginning of 274 Aurelian shifted his weight westwards: he had to face a Gallic Empire that refused to acknowledge the centre as well as Carausius, who had carved out a coastal state in Britain. On the Gallic side Zoticus had been ordered to march east in support of Zenobia and only after his defeat in 272 or 273 fell back into Tetricus' army, so the two theatres of the war were in truth the two ends of a single civil war. For Aurelian himself, the recovery of Gaul was also the necessary means of confirming his standing in the army: he consolidated his position by consulting the provinces and enforcing discipline, and he needed a victory that no one could dispute.
impact: 高盧帝國在這場戰役之後從地圖上消失，羅馬帝國重新取得高盧、不列顛與西班牙東部，奧勒良因此被尊為「世界的恢復者」（Restitutor Orbis），並在高盧與不列顛的幣上分別刻上「高盧的恢復者」與「不列顛的恢復者」。統一並不等於安定：不列顛的卡勞秀斯於286年再度自立，隨後由阿勒克圖斯接手，直到296年才被收復，中間形成獨立的海上帝國。奧勒良同時放棄達契亞行省，把軍力與稅收集中到萊茵與多瑙河防線，並推行含銀五成的凱撒幣改革，籌建奧勒良城牆，重整造幣與糧食儲備，為戴克里先的四帝共治與新稅制鋪路。東方則因帕爾米拉之役重新納入版圖，芝諾比亞被俘後成為羅馬貴族的財產，敘利亞的門戶大開。帝國版圖的完整恢復是這場戰役最大的成果，但三世紀的結構性問題並未因此消失。
impactEn: After this campaign the Gallic Empire disappeared from the map, and the Roman Empire recovered Gaul, Britain and eastern Hispania. Aurelian was accordingly honoured as Restitutor Orbis, restorer of the world, and his coins in Gaul and in Britain carry the separate titles Restitutor Galliae and Restitutor Britanniae. Unity was not the same as stability: Carausius declared himself independent of Rome again in 286, was succeeded by Allectus, and Britain was not recovered until 296, forming an independent maritime empire in between. At the same time Aurelian abandoned the province of Dacia, concentrating the army and the tax revenue on the Rhine and Danube lines, and carried out a reform of the antoninianus that put five per cent of silver back into the coinage; he began the Aurelian Walls at Rome and reorganised the mints and the grain reserves, paving the way for the tetrarchy and the new taxation of Diocletian. In the east the conquest of Palmyra brought Syria back into the empire, and Zenobia, taken prisoner, passed into the possession of the Roman aristocracy, leaving the doors of Syria open. The integrity of the Empire was the great result of this campaign, but the structural problems of the third century were not thereby removed.
result: 特里庫斯一世在會戰失利後投降，被奧勒良帶入科隆尼亞，《古史》與其他羅馬史家記載他以凱旋式進城之後仍遭處決，其王位與財富轉入羅馬中央；有史家另記其子被送往羅馬作人質而非受戮。高盧帝國的機構隨之解體：科隆的鑄幣廠改鑄奧勒良的錢幣，高盧各城重新派駐軍團與行政官，萊茵防線恢復羅馬的巡邏與堡壘體系。不列顛的問題沒有同時解決，奧勒良雖在274年底至275年一度登島並接受北部歸順，仍舊撤回萊茵。科隆尼亞的入城式被後世視為帝國西界重歸的象徵，奧勒良的「高盧的恢復者」名號也隨之鑄入當地錢幣；有史家稱特里庫斯的庫藏被運往羅馬，用以支撐造幣與城牆工程。274年是三世紀動亂由最壞轉向收束的關鍵一年，羅馬帝國在奧勒良手中重新統一，但他本人隨即在275年遇刺，這份成果最終由戴克里先的體制鞏固，並在其後百年間維持帝國邊界的基本格局。
resultEn: After his defeat Tetricus I surrendered, was brought by Aurelian to Colonia Agrippina and, according to the Historia Augusta and the other Roman historians, was executed after entering the city in a kind of triumph; his position and his treasure passed to the Roman centre, and some writers record that his son was sent to Rome as a hostage rather than put to death. The machinery of the Gallic Empire fell apart: the mints at Cologne struck Aurelian's coinage, the cities of Gaul again received garrison soldiers and administrators, and the Roman system of patrols and forts on the Rhine was restored. The problem of Britain was not solved at the same time: Aurelian entered the island late in 274 or in 275 and received the submission of the northern tribes, but still withdrew to the Rhine. The year 274 was the turning point at which the disorders of the third century began to close, and the Roman Empire was reunified in Aurelian's hands, though he was assassinated in 275. The entry into Colonia Agrippina came to be remembered as the sign that the western frontier of the Empire had been recovered, and the title of Aurelian as restorer of Gaul was struck into the coinage of the province; some writers add that the treasure of Tetricus was carried to Rome to pay for the coinage and the works on the city walls. The settlement he achieved was in the end made durable by the system of Diocletian, which held the frontiers of the Empire in their new shape for the following century.
